Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.util

Class StackGestures

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.util.StackGestures
public final class StackGestures extends Object
Which stack gesture a right-click makes, from the inputs both sides know: the Stack Modifier, sneaking, the selected mode, the main-hand item, and the clicked block's stack type. The server actions and the client's local claim both ask these, so the client consumes exactly the clicks the server acts on. Targeting inside a stack is the server's alone.
